sections.heading: Overview
content: This policy outlines Humana’s billing requirements and reimbursement for multiple evaluation and management (E/M) services performed on the same day by the same provider.

sections.heading: Kentucky Medicaid Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. The following policy applies to only professional services. Other than the exception outlined in this policy, Humana allows one E/M service when multiple E/M services are performed on the same date by the same provider. Exception When a problem-oriented E/M service and a preventive E/M service are both performed on the same date by the same provider, Humana allows reimbursement for both E/M services. The provider must report the problem-oriented E/M service with modifier 25 . Medical records must support the use of modifier 25 . Note: In certain circumstances, additional payment rules may apply. For example, when applicable, claims are subject to the Humana Healthy Horizons in Kentucky out-of-network payment policy. For more information, see the relevant guidance in the References section of this policy.

sections.heading: Definitions of Italicized Terms
content: • Modifier 25 : A significant, separately identifiable evaluation and management (E/M) service by the same physician or other qualified health care professional on the same day of a procedure or other service.
